description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 5/2019
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a regulatory amendment to the Excise Ordinance, specifically changing limits for the sale, transport, and possession of foreign liquor. It is issued under statutory authority (Sections 4, 13 and 17 of the Ordinance) and rescinds a previous notification. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory change, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is purely regulatory/legal in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
